searchText: I suspect its mostly staking pools eth1 addresses have been very popular with anyone paying attention to things as well (which is not as many stakers as you might expect…). It simplifies security a lot as you can just use the address from your hardware wallet and make it much harder to lose your whole stake accidentally. I just use the same seed in a hardware wallet for bls addresses and eth addresses I am always skeptical of higher entropy: I know eventually I can move to an ETH1 prefix, but not the other way around
